sentences: Dynamic s–t reachability asks whether a fixed target can be reached from a fixed source after directed edge updates.
The saved question asks for a deterministic fully dynamic algorithm with subquadratic time.
The ability to both insert and delete edges means reachability information can appear and disappear globally.
A better bound would strengthen deterministic maintenance for one of the simplest directed graph queries.
The excerpt does not state whether the time refers to updates, queries, or a combined convention, so the intended subquadratic target still needs the original model.
